reorganizarDica: Repositions the blocks in columns, from start to end

problemas.duplicate-node-id: Two blocks with the same identifier.
problemas.entry-not-found: The starting block does not exist.
problemas.target-not-found: Connection pointing to a block that does not exist.
problemas.loop-without-wait: Goes back without asking anything — the bot would spin on its own.
problemas.no-terminal-reachable: From this block there is no way to an ending nor to an agent.
problemas.escape-target-incomplete: Choose who the emergency exit transfers to.
problemas.duplicate-option-value: Two options with the same value.
problemas.self-target: Choose where the outputs of this block go.
problemas.handoff-target-incomplete: Choose who the conversation is handed to.
problemas.condition-var-invalid: The condition needs a variable to test.
problemas.node-text-missing: The text the bot sends in this block is missing.
problemas.schedule-path-missing: Both business hours paths are required.
problemas.unknown-var: This block uses a variable that does not exist in the flow.

canvas.legenda: Click + to add the next step · click the block to edit · click the line and press Delete to remove

bloco.inserirEntre: Insert a step between the two
